title: Local `name` renamed and `user.name` changed to `user.label` on the same line

title: Parameter `title` renamed and DOM property `el.title` changed along with it
expected: Parameter rename title -> caption; `el.title = ...` -> `el.caption = ...` writes a different (non-existent) DOM property and must be shown as an edit.

title: Destructured prop renamed and the child JSX attribute `size=` renamed with it
expected: Prop `size` -> `dimension` is a rename; `<Image size={...}>` -> `<Image dimension={...}>` passes a different prop to the child and is an edit.

title: Class field `value` renamed and `input.value` changed along with it
expected: Field rename value -> text for `this.value`; `input.value` -> `input.text` is a behaviour change on a DOM element.

title: Interface field renamed; fetch init key `headers:` renamed along with it
expected: Field rename RequestOptions.headers -> extraHeaders for `opts.headers`; `{ headers: ... }` -> `{ extraHeaders: ... }` in the fetch call silently drops the headers and is an edit.

title: Interface field renamed; `input.name` DOM write renamed along with it
expected: Rename FieldProps.name -> label for `p.name`; `input.name` -> `input.label` is an edit.

expected: Rename Props.title -> heading for `p.title`; `document.heading = doc.heading` is a behaviour change on unrelated objects.
